remarks: * 0.5 mi to Cove Island Beach * 0.7 mi to Chelsea Piers * 2 mi to Express Metro-North * Built in 2012/2013 * 9' ceilings * New 2025 HVAC & hot water system * Private fenced yard * Attached two-car garage* Low HOA fees * Elegant free-standing townhouse in Stamford's desirable Cove neighborhood offering 3 bedrooms, 2 full and 2 half baths, and 2,400 sq ft of refined living space, this residence lives like a single-family home yet provides the ease of low-maintenance living. The open main level features 9-foot ceilings, white oak floors, and a gas fireplace with custom built-ins. The gourmet kitchen showcases a granite island, stainless appliances, walk-in pantry, and designer lighting. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a cove ceiling, custom closets, and a spa bath with dual vanities and glass shower. Two additional bedrooms, hall bath, and laundry complete this level. The walkout ground level offers a flexible office or den, powder room, and access to a private fenced yard with bluestone patio. New HVAC and hot water-on-demand (2025). Attached two-car garage. Low HOA fee $175/mo. Minutes to beaches, Chelsea Piers multi-sports facility, dining, and Stamford's Metro-North station.
